They can spit out balls of [[Ice]] that break into bursts of cold air when they make contact with the ground. They have a moderate amount of health at 288. Hitting an Ice-Breath Lizalfos with a [[Fire]] attack, such as with [[Fire Arrow]]s or a [[Flameblade]], evaporates it instantly. They are mostly found in snowy areas, such as the northern [[Gerudo Highlands]] and the [[Hebra Mountains]]. When defeated, they may drop [[Lizalfos Horn]]s, [[Lizalfos Talon]]s, and [[Icy Lizalfos Tail]]s. ====Drops==== {{Collapsible |header= Drops of Ice-Breath Lizalfos |collapse= true |content= {{Tabs |- | Normal | {{Drop Table |game= BotW |- | Icy Lizalfos Tail | 1 | 100 % |- | Lizalfos Talon | 2 | 100 % |- | Lizalfos Horn | 1 | 100 % }} |- | IceArrow | {{Drop Table |game= BotW |- | Ice Arrow x5 | 1 | 50 % |- | Icy Lizalfos Tail | 1 | 50 % |- | Lizalfos Horn | 1
